What I do each season

Spring

Spring is cleanup time. I clear the beds out after winter. Then fresh mulch and a clean edge finish them off. The mowing starts up again.

  • Spring cleanups
  • Mulch and bed edging
  • Planting beds and shrubs
  • Lawn mowing

Summer

Summer is mostly about the lawn. I keep it mowed and looked after. It is also a good time to ask me about a small paver patio or a walkway.

  • Lawn mowing and care
  • Small paver patios and walkways

Fall

In fall I take care of the leaves and cut the beds back. The mowing carries on into fall as well.

  • Fall cleanups
  • Lawn mowing

What I can do for your yard

Plan your yard

  • Planting beds and shrubs

    I dig and plant new beds, or fill out the ones you already have with new shrubs.

  • Mulch and bed edging

    Fresh mulch on the beds and a clean cut edge where they meet the lawn. It is the part that makes a bed look finished.

  • Lawn mowing and care

    From spring into fall I mow and look after lawns. Call me to talk about how often yours needs a cut.

  • Spring and fall cleanups

    In spring I clear the beds out after winter. In fall I take care of the leaves and cut the beds back.

  • Small paver patios and walkways

    A small patio by the back door, or a paver walk from the driveway to the front steps. Give me a rough idea of the size when you call.

  • Something else in the yard

    Tell me about any other yard job you have in mind. I’ll let you know if I can take it on.

    Questions, answered

    What kind of work do you take on?

    I plant garden beds and shrubs and finish them with fresh mulch and a clean edge. Lawns get mowed and looked after through the season. Cleanups happen in spring and fall. Small paver patios and walkways round out the list.

    Do you work in my area?

    Call me with your address and I’ll tell you if your street is one I cover.

    What should I tell you when I call?

    Your address and what you’d like done in the yard. If you’re not sure yet, we can talk it over.

    Can you take on a job that isn’t listed here?

    Call and tell me what you have in mind, and I’ll let you know.
